what the company does, from its own site (title and description)

TrustScale's home page (read 7 November 2026, 18:30 UTC, rendered in a headless browser because the page is built by script): the TrustScale Loop: Nuance defines the customer's criteria, Argus automates evaluation (every claim checked against evidence, with sources, a TrustScore and a correction), Humanus brings in an expert for edge cases, and results feed back into the model; it covers corpus, models, agents (prompt injection) and applications (the flow the-trustscale-loop).
